people.name: Belshazzar
people.line: The last Emperor of Babylon, son of Nabonidus.

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
translations.bsb: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, Daniel, subsequent to the one that had appeared to me earlier.
translations.kjv: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
translations.asv: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me, Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
